children.name: custom_fonts
children.label: Custom Fonts
children.help_text: When enabling custom fonts, all font fields will be disabled. You will need to apply the desired font styles to specific elements using CSS.

children.name: width
children.label: Width
children.help_text: Control the maximum width of the header content. Container uses theme's default container width (1800px). Default uses theme's small container width (968px). Small and Large use their respective theme container widths. Full Width allows content to span the entire viewport width.

children.name: fixed
children.label: Fixed
children.help_text: By checking this option additional fields for a logo (Content -> Logo), background color (Style -> Menu -> Background), and font color (Style -> Menu -> Text) will be made available. These options will enable you to dynamically alter the color of your navigation as the user scrolls down the page.

children.name: scroll
children.label: Hide on Scroll Down
children.help_text: Make the navigation disappear as the user scrolls down the page, and reappear when they scroll up.

children.name: floating_navigation
children.label: Floating Navigation
children.help_text: Make the navigation float in the container

children.name: mobile_breakpoint
children.label: Mobile Breakpoint
children.help_text: Breakpoint at which the navigation layout changes to include a toggle button. Set to 968px to align with the Small container width (968px) for consistent breakpoints. If your menu is particularly wide, you may need to increase this value to prevent wrapping before switching to mobile.

children.name: background
children.label: Background
children.inline_help_text: Set opacity to 0 to disable the background.

children.name: aria_label
children.label: Aria Label
children.help_text: The aria-label attribute is used on links that have no accessible name to give it meaning to screen readers.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

children.name: rich_text
children.label: Rich Text
children.default: This announcement is great for any announcement whether temporary or permanent.

default.rich_text: This announcement is great for any announcement whether temporary or permanent.

children.name: max_levels
children.label: Max levels
children.help_text:
Determines the number of menu tree children that can be expanded in the menu.

Note: Items with child items will not be clickable.

name: language_switcher
label: Language switcher
inline_help_text: By adding a language switcher you can allow your visitors to select their preferred language. Custom multi-language content will not be translated automatically. Learn More

children.name: enabled
children.label: Enabled
children.help_text: The language switcher will only appear if there is a multi-language variation for a page.

children.name: display_mode
children.label: Display mode
children.help_text: The language of the text in the language switcher. PageLang means the names of languages will display in the language of the page the switcher is on. Localized means the name of each language will display in that language. Hybrid is a combination of the two.

children.name: image
children.label: Icon Image
children.help_text: Image to display for language switcher button (e.g., globe icon). If provided, this will replace the text-based language tag display.

children.name: purpose
children.label: Purpose
children.help_text: The purpose of the icon, used for accessibility. If set to decorative, an additional attribute of aria-hidden="true" will be added to the icon.

name: search
label: Search
inline_help_text: Use the site search input module to help visitors search your site. Search results are displayed on your search results system page or by adding the search results module. Learn more

children.name: use_custom_search_results_template
children.label: Use custom search results page
children.help_text: Turn this setting on to use a custom search results page instead of the default global search results page.

children.name: path_id
children.label: Search results page
children.help_text: This is where people will go when they click to search their search term. Make sure to choose a page that contains the search results module.

children.name: heading_display_size
